targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-634 (2026-06-03) full-scale readiness validation of the scaffolded_sd054_onboarding nursery amend FAILED the substrate gate (substrate_gate_passed=false, branch=substrate_not_engaged). Stage-0 forced-feed positive control PASSES 3/3 (z_goal_norm_peak 0.40-0.45 > 0.4) -- the nursery half of the amend is validated; goal-formation wiring is sound. But P1 survival passes only 1/3 (seed 43), P2 ecological contact only 1/3 (seed 44), and P2 mature-test z_goal is ~0 on all 3 seeds (0/3). The seed that survives makes no contact; the seed that contacts does not survive. The amend is necessary-but-insufficient: forced-feed goal formation works, but the P0/P1 survival-foraging scaffold does not reliably carry >=2/3 seeds to self-sustaining contact, so the goal representation is not maintained in the wild. Substrate stays NOT ready (ready=false); do not queue 603f.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Strengthen P0/P1 survival-foraging scaffold (nursery/forced-feed half proven; wean-to-wild half insufficient)
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: 634 readiness validation proved the run_stage0_nursery forced-feed half (G0 z_goal 0.40-0.45 > 0.4, 3/3) but FAILED the wean-to-wild half: P1 survival 1/3, P2 contact 1/3, P2 z_goal 0/3, substrate_gate_passed=false. Strengthen and/or lengthen the P0/P1 survival-foraging curriculum (e.g. richer reef-refuge / lower early hazard density / longer P0-P1 budget / staged hazard ramp) so >=2/3 seeds reach self-sustaining ecological contact and maintain z_goal in the mature test. Seed 43's 200-step P1 survival shows the target is reachable; the scaffold is not yet reliable across seeds. Keep ready=false until a re-validation clears G1+G2+G3 on >=2/3 seeds. Do NOT queue V3-EXQ-603f until then.
